summary.zh: 东亚常见的行道树与寺庙古树，揉碎叶片有樟脑香气。
summary.en: A common East Asian avenue and temple tree whose crushed leaves smell of camphor.

field_marks.zh: 常绿乔木，叶互生、离基三出脉，脉腋有小腺窝；揉碎有樟脑香气。
field_marks.en: Evergreen tree with alternate leaves, three-veined from near the base, with small domatia in the vein axils; crushed leaves smell of camphor.

story.zh: 樟科属于木兰类，是早期分化的被子植物分支之一，不属于真双子叶植物。同科的台湾樟（Cinnamomum kanehirae）基因组帮助确定了木兰类在被子植物中的位置。
story.en: Lauraceae belongs to the magnoliids, an early-diverging flowering plant lineage outside the eudicots. The genome of the related stout camphor (Cinnamomum kanehirae) helped place magnoliids on the angiosperm tree.

note.zh: 该基因组来自同属的牛樟（C. kanehirae），不是樟本种。
note.en: The genome is from congener C. kanehirae, not C. camphora itself.

notes.zh: 3–4 月老叶集中更替，新叶呈红褐色，是春季观赏点。古樟常被奉为神木，参观时勿攀折。
notes.en: Old leaves are shed in March–April while reddish new leaves emerge. Ancient trees are often sacred; do not climb or break branches.
